passages.sermon:
This is a psalm.
This psalm gives thanks.
The writer expresses gratitude to God.

passages.text: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth.
passages.sermon: This is a psalm of thanksgiving.\r\nThe LORD is God.\r\nAll the earth must make a joyful noise to the LORD.
passages.original: מִזְמ֥וֹר לְתוֹדָ֑ה הָרִ֥יעוּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Serve the LORD with gladness; come into His presence with joyful songs.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
He deserves our service.
Serve the LORD with gladness.
Come before Him with joyful songs.
passages.original: עִבְד֣וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה בְּשִׂמְחָ֑ה בֹּ֥אוּ לְ֝פָנָ֗יו בִּרְנָנָֽה׃

passages.text: Know that the LORD is God. It is He who made us, and we are His; we are His people, and the sheep of His pasture.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
He made us.
We belong to Him.
We are His people.
We are the sheep of His pasture.
passages.original: דְּע֗וּ כִּֽי־ יְהוָה֮ ה֤וּא אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים הֽוּא־ עָ֭שָׂנוּ וְלֹא אֲנַ֑חְנוּ עַ֝מּ֗וֹ וְצֹ֣אן מַרְעִיתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Enter His gates with thanksgiving and His courts with praise; give thanks to Him and bless His name.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
He made us.
We belong to Him.
We are His people.
We are the sheep of His pasture.
Enter the LORD’s gates with thanksgiving.
Enter His courts with praise.
Give thanks to the LORD.
Bless His name.
passages.original: בֹּ֤אוּ שְׁעָרָ֨יו׀ בְּתוֹדָ֗ה חֲצֵרֹתָ֥יו בִּתְהִלָּ֑ה הֽוֹדוּ־ ל֝֗וֹ בָּרֲכ֥וּ שְׁמֽוֹ׃

passages.text: For the LORD is good, and His loving devotion endures forever; His faithfulness continues to all generations.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is good.
The LORD always shows loving devotion.
The LORD’s loving devotion never ends.
The LORD is faithful.
The LORD’s faithfulness lasts through every generation.
passages.original: כִּי־ ט֣וֹב יְ֭הֹוָה לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְעַד־ דֹּ֥ר וָ֝דֹ֗ר אֱמוּנָתֽוֹ׃
